managed-mcp-settings.title: MCP
managed-mcp-settings.description: Manage MCP servers on a selected Runner Device.
managed-mcp-settings.chooseRunner: Choose a Runner Device to inspect its MCP catalog.
managed-mcp-settings.future: Changes apply to future execution generations. Opening Settings never starts an MCP server.
managed-mcp-settings.readHelp: Check the selected Runner connection, permissions and managed MCP capability, then refresh.
managed-mcp-settings.invalid: The Runner catalog could not be verified. Refresh before making changes.
managed-mcp-settings.unsupported: Native execution is not supported by any verified harness.
managed-mcp-settings.writeHelp: Inspect the original operation before another change. A revision conflict requires a fresh read.
managed-mcp-settings.uncertain: The original operation has not been confirmed. Its exact request is retained; it will not be resent.
managed-mcp-settings.recovery: The original operation remains pending or requires recovery. Inspect again after the Runner recovers.
managed-mcp-settings.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” from this Runner catalog? Current Agent references block deletion.
managed-mcp-settings.retained: Retained execution copies and protected credentials keep their original ownership. Their cleanup is separate.
managed-mcp-settings.name: Name
managed-mcp-settings.invalidArguments: Enter arguments as a JSON array of strings.
managed-mcp-settings.writeOnly: Credentials are write-only and stored by the selected Runner. They are never displayed or exported.
managed-mcp-settings.rejected: The original operation was rejected. Inspect the current definition before submitting a new request.
managed-mcp-settings.duplicateKeys: Each protected value needs a different name.
